content.value_statement: New Imaginify users need clear guidance for creative tools and SaaS setup. This skill explains features, tutorials, and best practices for Imaginify.
actual_capabilities: Introduces Imaginify and points users to the official website.
Explains Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Background Remover, Photo Restoration, and Blur Background tools.
Provides step-by-step guidance for common Imaginify workflows.
Shares practical prompt and image preparation tips for better results.
Explains Imaginify as a Next.js 15, React 19, Drizzle ORM, and Better Auth SaaS boilerplate.
Suggests when users should explore account, plan, or API options on the site.
limitations: It does not operate an Imaginify account or upload user files.
It does not generate, edit, restore, or download images directly.
It may not reflect current pricing, limits, or live product changes.
It depends on the feature descriptions included in the skill files.

use_cases.title: Start With Imaginify
use_cases.description: Get a simple overview of Imaginify, its image tools, and the best first workflow to try.

use_cases.title: Improve Creative Results
use_cases.description: Learn how to prepare prompts and images for generation, background removal, restoration, and blur effects.

use_cases.title: Assess The Boilerplate
use_cases.description: Understand the stated tech stack and how Imaginify may support an AI SaaS product build.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Overview
prompt_templates.scenario: You want a quick introduction before visiting the site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what Imaginify is, list its main image tools, and tell me where to get started.

prompt_templates.title: Tool Tutorial
prompt_templates.scenario: You want instructions for one Imaginify feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to use the Background Remover in Imaginify, with steps and best-practice tips.

prompt_templates.title: Workflow Selection
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to choose the right feature for a creative task.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to improve a portrait and create a new social image. Which Imaginify tools should I use and why?

prompt_templates.title: Developer Evaluation
prompt_templates.scenario: You are comparing SaaS boilerplate options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate Imaginify as a foundation for an AI image SaaS. Cover the stated stack, likely strengths, and questions to verify.

output_examples.output: Imaginify is an AI image platform and SaaS boilerplate. It supports image generation, image editing, background removal, restoration, and portrait blur workflows.

output_examples.input: How do I use the background remover?
output_examples.output: The skill gives a clear workflow: sign in, choose Background Remover, upload an image, preview the result, and download the transparent output.
The skill explains the stated Next.js 15, React 19, Drizzle ORM, and Better Auth stack, then suggests product questions to verify.

best_practices: Ask for the specific Imaginify tool you want to learn or compare.
Describe your image goal, source image quality, and desired output format.
Verify live pricing, credits, API access, and feature availability on the official site.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to upload images or control your Imaginify account.
Do not rely on it as the only source for current pricing or account limits.
Do not use vague creative prompts when you need specific visual results.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It explains Imaginify features, tutorials, image workflow tips, and the stated SaaS boilerplate stack.

faq.question: Can it create images for me?
faq.answer: No. It gives guidance for using Imaginify, but it does not generate or edit images directly.

faq.question: Which Imaginify tools are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Background Remover, Photo Restoration, and Blur Background.

faq.question: Does it include developer guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes Imaginify as a Next.js 15 SaaS boilerplate with React 19, Drizzle ORM, and Better Auth.

faq.question: Does it check live product details?
faq.answer: No. Verify current pricing, usage limits, API access, and feature availability on the official site.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
